name: Separation of duties
short_description: An internal control principle, also called segregation of duties (SoD), that requires more than one person or identity to complete a sensitive task so that no single actor can both perform and approve it.

evidence.quote: Segregation of duties is the paper shield that looks strongest and fails quietest
the part most enterprises avoid because it creates conflict, separating duties
It does not helpfully bypass segregation of duties because the user sounds urgent.
